entries.en: The owner is a beginner and prefers short answers in plain Korean: lead with the answer, keep jargon out, use tables when they help.

The owner gives terse Korean instructions and holds agents to previously agreed procedures; every commit or deploy report must carry real verification evidence (commands run and their results), not claims. Reporting the evidence is not a request for approval.
Never present synthetic or mocked QA as production evidence.

When a connection fails, first rule out settings the agent itself changed by testing with real requests before blaming the provider or suggesting support; clearly correct any earlier wrong explanation.
For Figma work, 'change the existing drawing' means edit the named frames in place (e.g. frames 1-11); do not propose a copy. Keep earlier outputs and add new ones alongside.
Split work by content, never to fit a runtime limit. Progress should show real activity (skills loaded, commands run, files written), not just 'working'.
A cancelled task is marked cancelled, not done, and its records and outputs are kept. A restart is a new request with a new folder (agent-work/restart/<request id>/).
The owner checks results on the AgentOS dashboard screen itself (e.g. an agent's Skills field); confirm the visible screen, not only the backend, before reporting done.

The owner runs the Korean cooking academy 한국조리기능장요리발효학원 (website kmastercook.com). Its Gemini API key is only for the website's AI consultation chatbot, never for content generation (separate endpoint).
Worktree copies have no git identity. Commit with `git -c user.name="<bot name>" -c user.email="agent-<first 8 chars of agent id>@paperclip.local" commit`; never change git config files.
A source repo folder may hold other people's uncommitted changes; never stage, move, or commit them.
jq is not installed; build and read JSON with `node -e`.
`npx tsc` may print npm notices first. Redirect output to a file and check `$?`; piping into grep returns grep's exit code instead.
Upload an issue document with PUT /api/issues/:id/documents/:key and body {title, format: "markdown", body}.

Paperclip runs expose PAPERCLIP_API_URL and PAPERCLIP_API_KEY but no PAPERCLIP_RUN_ID; use the Run ID from the wake message for X-Paperclip-Run-Id. Paperclip writes: comments and documents that do not change the task status may be sent with Python urllib (json.dumps ensure_ascii=False, UTF-8). Status changes to done or in_progress must stay readable by agentos-guard: send them with curl, as a heredoc (--data-binary @- <<'EOF') or from a JSON file written in an earlier command (--data-binary @<absolute path>); a Python/Node program that PATCHes a status is blocked. For Korean text prefer the heredoc or the file over an inline -d.

New bots need board approval: agent-hires only creates a pending hire that the boss approves in Paperclip, and only 비서실장 hires (via scripts/hermes-bots.mjs hire). Org-chart apply needs expectedVersion, which rises by 1 per operation.
The owner's desktop Hermes has the official Figma MCP (mcp.figma.com, OAuth), so Figma links can be read for design context.

Knowledge is split by scope: agentos-common (every bot), agentos-project-<key> (only bots assigned to that project), agentos-bot-<profile> (one bot's specialist notes). The source is knowledge/data/registry.json in the AgentOS repo; generated skills must not be edited by hand. Store memory entries in English; the dashboard shows a Korean translation.

The AgentOS repo is /mnt/c/Users/tahar/orca/workspaces/agent os (Windows: C:\Users\tahar\orca\workspaces\agent os). In WSL, git status can flag CRLF-only changes; check real changes with `git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol`.

agent-os is a single repo whose base branch is `main` at C:/Users/tahar/orca/workspaces/agent os (origin GitHub ByoungOhBAE/agent-os, which is PUBLIC: never commit secrets or private operating details). Other branches or leftover folders under .worktrees/ may exist; never reuse them — always make a fresh team/<topic> worktree from main.

Only for bots whose role allows code or document changes (read-only roles such as review never commit): For a code or document change, make a per-task worktree from the latest main: re-check `git log -1 main` right before, then `git worktree add -b team/<topic> .worktrees/<topic> main`, and report if main moved. Never edit or commit tracked files in the original checkout (git-ignored work folders such as plugins/agentos-youtube/agent-work/ are not part of the checkout for this rule). Merge into main (`git merge --ff-only team/<topic>`) only when the task asks for it. When done, remove only the worktree (`git worktree remove .worktrees/<topic>`) and leave the branch for review; bots cannot delete branches (agentos-guard blocks `git branch -d/-D`), the owner deletes merged branches.
Keep work inside the requested folder and files. Run `git status --porcelain` before starting: anything already changed belongs to someone else, so never stage, move or commit it.

The agentos-hermes plugin is React 19 + TypeScript + vitest with no Tailwind, chart library, Testing Library, or react-dom. All CSS lives in the `styles` string of src/ui/index.tsx under the `.agentos-hermes` prefix (no CSS file is loaded); tokens --h-* (background #101716, card #161e1c, accent #bdd1aa). Test logic by extracting pure functions into src/*.ts.

The AgentOS BFF (127.0.0.1:4200) serves read-only GETs: /api/hermes/bots, /api/hermes/learning/graph?profile=, /api/hermes/skills?profile=. Hermes profile ids encode Hangul as uXXXX, so use bots[].title for names.

Plugin SDK methods need manifest capabilities (e.g. agents.read; local.folders plus a localFolders declaration); see plugin-sdk dist/host-client-factory.js. Adding capabilities or localFolders requires reinstalling the plugin and choosing folders, an operational change that needs the owner's approval.
With bot permissions, other bots' adapterConfig reads as {} and /api/agents/:id/skills is refused; report such data as unverified.
The plugin SDK test harness createTestHarness returns configured:false when localFolders is unset; verify that write functions are never called by using a vi.fn fake ctx.
Hermes /journey memory cards are translated to Korean only in the display layer (learning_graph.py view); never change the source text, IDs, cursor, or edit behaviour.

academy-homepage is a single git repo (branch main, origin GitHub ByoungOhBAE/academy-homepage) at C:/Users/tahar/orca/workspaces/academy homepage. On 2026-10-03 the old worktrees (master at C:/Users/tahar/academy homepage, 홈페이지제작, etc.) were consolidated and removed; work here.

academy-homepage (Next.js) runs on the NAS with docker-compose: app (port 3080, domain kmastercook.com) + cloudflared tunnel 'academy' + backup container. Never run compose up on the PC (it would hijack the production tunnel). Deploy: build the image on the PC (the 2 GB NAS cannot build) -> docker save/load over SSH -> recreate only the academy service. Project /volume1/docker/academy; docker binary /var/packages/ContainerManager/target/usr/bin/docker; passwordless sudo covers only that binary. Preserve ./data (db.sqlite, uploads, originals) and compare row and file counts before and after. Review migrate deploy and seed before deploying. Bots never deploy to or connect to the NAS; deployment is done only by the boss's own Hermes session.

academy-homepage conventions: edit agent/skill definitions only under .claude/skills and .claude/agents, then `npm run agents:sync` regenerates the .agents/ and .codex/ mirrors; `npm run agents:check` asserts zero drift (runs in pretest). Verify with npm test (node --test), npx tsc --noEmit, npx eslint. Content-generator prompts are assembled only through applyGrounding() in src/lib/prompt-defaults.ts, shared by server actions and local-worker.

academy-homepage status: subscription content generation is strict with no fallback (local-worker/strict_subscription.py calls only the chosen provider once, fail-closed). The Gemini API (gemini-3.8-flash) serves only the web consultation chat. The hero banner AI studio (2880x1125, hero-studio) is deployed: model choice, free placement on a white canvas with 8-way rotation-aware resize, folder-style photo picker, per-part create/preserve policy. Key files: src/components/admin/HeroBannerStudio.tsx, HeroPhotoPicker.tsx, src/lib/hero-studio/*, scripts/hero-studio-inspect.mjs (isolated browser QA; update its selectors when the UI changes). Details: academy-hero-studio and academy-content-generator skills.
Check the homepage UI at real user eye level on responsive widths (position, size, readability). Verify that DB rows and photo files are preserved before and after every deploy.

Academy public writing: tone is 'professional yet friendly' (not a stiff report, not hype); readers are people interested in cooking and fermentation and prospective students. Banned: unfounded superlatives (best, perfect, special, No.1), promises of exam success or health effects (immunity, diet, efficacy), prices or tuition, and facts not given (class dates, prices, reviews, statistics, awards, instructor names). General cooking/fermentation facts may be used only with a public source link in the done comment; academy facts never. A recruiting line for a specific class is allowed only when the task gives that class's details; award or opening news from kmastercook.com/notices is not used in titles unless the task says so. Source of these rules: src/lib/prompt-defaults.ts and content-quality-policy.ts in C:/Users/tahar/orca/workspaces/academy homepage.

Limbus Company mirror-dungeon service 'Mirror Ledger' (Electron overlay + strategy web, login and subscription): C:\Users\tahar\orca\workspaces\rimbus company project (plan docs/plan/PLAN.md). Four Paperclip bots work on it (림버스_계획수립가, 림버스_개발자, 림버스_디자이너, reviewer 림버스_검수검토자); work arrives only as Paperclip tasks — the old desktop group chat room is no longer used. Never commit or upload game text or images (© Project Moon).

agent-work rules: a first analysis of a video writes to agent-work/demo/<video id>/; a restart of a cancelled request (HER-17 pattern) writes to agent-work/restart/<request>/bot/ and only reads the original demo/<video id>/. Source env/setenv.sh first so uv, pip and HF caches and TMP stay inside agent-work/env (otherwise files once landed in the global uv cache). env/tools/extract_frames.py deletes frames/*/*.jpg in its target and vision_note.py writes to D/report/, so for new work extract frames with ffmpeg into B directly and keep viewing notes in B/vision_seen.json. runlog/progress (first argument = result folder) and pc_api.py (get/comment/doc-put/attach; key only from the environment) live in env/tools/. `pc_api.py patch` is blocked by agentos-guard: status changes (done/blocked) go through curl so the guard can read the comment body.

Video report evidence format: one sentence per line ending with [자막 mm:ss] / [음성전사 mm:ss] / [화면 mm:ss] / [보충] / [보충: 설명란]; quotes copy the original text exactly inside double quotes followed by the evidence tag. Known pitfalls: youtube-content fetch_transcript.py fails with 'No transcript found' unless given --language ko; seeking ffmpeg -ss to a rounded pts_time from frames.json can land one frame late (the true source time gives identical pixels); vision_analyze readings vanish on context compression, so write each frame's reading to a file right away.

Blog-title task output: the issue document 'titles' holds only a '| 번호 | 제목 | 한 줄 설명 |' table; the done comment is one '## 완료' 4-item comment (한 일/확인 방법/증거/남은 일) with the same table + a self-check table (기준 | 결과, with each title's length including spaces counted by a program) + the memories saved this time appended under it; then the issue is set to done. Count and length limits follow the task description exactly (e.g. titles within 40 characters including spaces, description a single sentence without line breaks).
`npx skills find <query>` searches without installing. Strip colour codes with sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'. GitHub stars come from api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo> and count the whole repository.
To prove nothing was installed, compare the company skill list (GET /api/companies/{id}/skills) and the ~/.claude/skills folder listing before and after the task.
The Claude runtime has built-in dataviz and code-review skills; mark similar external skills as overlapping ('겹침').

In the chief's sessions HERMES_HOME is my own profile folder, not the Hermes root. hermes-bots.mjs passes the root to its child tools since commit 48630ac, but still run hire and similar commands as HERMES_HOME="C:/Users/tahar/AppData/Local/hermes" node.exe .... Profile removal is only `node scripts/hermes-bots.mjs retire --profile <pc-…>` (hermes profile delete is blocked by agentos-guard).
